I am an 80-year-old farmer in North East Nigeria, and I have been working this land since I was a young man. My beans plot is intercropped as my father taught me, and I know that beans can draw nitrogen from the air, so I will not waste money on chemical fertilizer when manure from my animals is available and sufficient. I have saved my own seed for many years, though I will buy a small amount of pesticide to protect the pods from insects, because last year the pod borers took too much of my crop. At my age, I cannot do all the weeding and harvesting alone, so my sons and grandchildren will work the plot with me, but I will still need to hire some young men from the village when the harvest is heavy.
